# Files deliberately unreachable from every cargo target root.
#
# A .rs file that no `mod` statement names is never compiled, never linted, and never
# formatted — silently. That cost this repo 29 test functions in three protocol suites plus
# two whole test trees (see .github/workflows/ci.yml, job `module-reachability`).
#
# Anything listed here is exempt from BOTH gates in that job: the reachability check and the
# rustfmt sweep. That is the whole point — these files are dead, and formatting dead code
# would only make it look maintained. Every entry is a debt, not a policy.
#
# Rules:
#   * one repo-relative path per line; `#` starts a comment
#   * every entry needs a reason and an exit condition
#   * an entry that no longer applies (file deleted, or now reachable) is reported as stale
#     and should be removed — that is a warning, not a failure, so reviving a module never
#     breaks master on a bookkeeping detail
#
# The list should only ever shrink.

# --- Dead client protocols -------------------------------------------------------------
# `src/client/mod.rs` has these two commented out ("temporarily disabled (API fixes needed)"
# / "(needs API updates)"). The sources were left on disk, compile against nothing, and are
# the only unformatted code in src/. Remove these entries when the clients are either
# deleted or repaired and re-declared. Leaving dead modules on disk is how `Http2Server`
# stayed dead for months.
src/client/rss/mod.rs
src/client/rss/actions.rs
src/client/tftp/mod.rs
src/client/tftp/actions.rs

# --- Dead TUI modules ------------------------------------------------------------------
# `src/ui/mod.rs` declares only `pub mod app;`. These two predate the rolling TUI and
# nothing references `ui::events` or `ui::layout`. Delete them or wire them back in.
src/ui/events.rs
src/ui/layout.rs
